sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's >>= operator silently propagates Nothing, so an entire chain of meaningful computations collapses to Nothing if any single step fails.
A generator function that yields once and then returns — the caller can only call next() one more time before StopIteration is raised permanently.
The lateinit keyword declares a variable that must be initialized before use, but accessing it before initialization throws UninitializedPropertyAccessException at runtime.
